brief.name: QuillCards
brief.category: Language-learning app (fictional), flashcards and short stories
brief.pitch: QuillCards turns two-minute stories into a spaced-repetition flashcard deck, so adults learning a second language can tap the words they don't know and review them later.
mechanics: Learners read a two-minute story in the target language
Tapping an unknown word adds it to a spaced-repetition deck
Spaced-repetition review schedules the saved words over time
Audio of each word is recorded by native speakers
A streak calendar tracks daily study
brief.art_style: Friendly book-cover illustration with warm, hand-finished shapes and a storybook feel
facts: QuillCards is a fictional language-learning app.
Learners read two-minute stories in the app.
Tapping unknown words adds them to a spaced-repetition deck.
Audio is recorded by native speakers.
The app includes a streak calendar.
The target audience is adults learning a second language.
The visual style is friendly book-cover illustration.
not_true: QuillCards is not certified exam prep.
QuillCards does not offer real-money rewards.
QuillCards is not a real product and does not reference real brands.
brief.launch_goal: Drive installs from adults learning a second language.
